body:
Manual GUI test passed on 2026-11-21 at head `2e8be791db2a9fe02e8da7055e5989d53f97dce6`.

I tested the `O4 Cam Plate master` project with a 2D Contour:
- Entry type: Plunge
- Lead in/out: None
- Lead out type: None
- Before lead-in: 0.0 mm
- After lead-out: 0.0 mm
- Overlap past the start: 0.0 mm

The generated viewport path has no lead-in at the contour seam. The cut starts directly on the contour.

Manual regression test passed on 2026-11-21 at head `2e8be791db2a9fe02e8da7055e5989d53f97dce6`.

On `O4 Cam Plate master`, I tested Entry type Plunge and Arc. With Lead in/out None, Lead out None, and zero extensions/overlap, the seam had no lead-in and the cut started directly on the contour.

I also changed Lead in/out from Linear to Arc and back to None. Each selected lead shape appeared only while selected; None removed the lead each time.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 2e8be791db2a9fe02e8da7055e5989d53f97dce6 -->
Needs changes before merge.

This is a SAFETY-tier review. The change affects contour entry motion and posted output.
I reviewed the laws from current upstream main, `acc01cd228bfc26ee394e25157dd7a2ba6ab1852`.
The local trial merge with that main was clean. No GitHub runner was used.

What looks good:
- The change uses the existing grazing dive and its centre-cutting refusal.
- The tests use `EditOperationParams` and `GenerateOperation`.
- No goldens, UI files, fixtures, dependencies, or process files changed.
- The manual test comments report the result on the user's project. These are supporting evidence, not local test results.

Requested before merge:
1. `crates/app/tests/contour_none_lead.rs:33`: add the required `chain_overrides` field to this `OpParams::Contour` initializer. Current main added this field. The merged tree fails to compile the new test. Run the quick gate and clippy again after the fix.
2. `crates/motion/src/machining2d/contour.rs:259` and the PR body's "Not exercised" section: run the reached heavy lanes on the final head. Record their results in the body. Current upstream AGENTS.md, "Heavy lanes at review", requires these results before readiness. `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run` reaches the motion and app heavy lanes. The body explicitly says they did not run. The dry run is not a pass.

Results merged with main, locally:
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: FAIL. 26 steps, 24 passed, 2 failed, 5.8 minutes. The app prebuild and `contour_none_lead` both fail on the same compile error.
- `CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 RUSTC_WRAPPER=sccache cargo clippy -j 16 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: FAIL on the same error.

```text
error[E0063]: missing field `chain_overrides` in initializer of `OpParams`
  --> crates/app/tests/contour_none_lead.rs:33:5
   |
33 |     OpParams::Contour {
   |     ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ missing `chain_overrides`
```

Mutations: not run. The new test does not compile on the trial merge, so no red/green mutation result is available. The required two mutation checks remain unverified. The body reports only one mutation: restoring main's `contour.rs`. Repeat that check and a second independent mutation after the build fix.

Heavy lanes: plan inspected only; not run. The new test's build failure blocks a complete safety review.

The PR remains a draft and receives `needs-rework`.
A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
